Data.Duty:
Supplier Development & Strategic Sourcing:
· Identify, assess, and onboard strategic suppliers to meet demand of company
· Lead supplier capability audits, technical reviews, and capacity planning – ensuring alignment with product roadmaps.
· Drive long-term partnership models with key suppliers, focusing on quality, cost, technology, and delivery (QCTD).
 
Cross-functional Collaboration (Internal):
· Act as the communication interface between Engineering, Program Management, and Suppliers.
· Participate in early supplier involvement (ESI) during NPI (New Product Introduction), advising on DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and material selection.
· Support program managers with component lead times, risk mitigation, and sourcing milestones.
 
Project Management & Execution:
· Manage sourcing projects from early development to production ramp, ensuring on-time release of tooling, samples, and related documents.
· Drive value engineering (VAVE) and cost reduction initiatives without compromising performance.
 
Communication & Leadership:
· Lead sourcing meetings with across functional  – fluent English required.
· Escalate and resolve critical supply, quality, or technical issues under high pressure.
· Mentor junior sourcing staff if required.
Data.Require:
Must-Have:
· 10+ years of total working experience, with at least 3 years in engineering (product design, NPI, manufacturing engineering, or mechanical design) – connectors, electronics packaging, or precision mechanical components preferred.
· Strong project management experience (e.g., leading cross-functional tasks, tracking milestones, risk management).
· Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Materials Engineering, or related field.
· Fluent in English (both written and spoken) – must be able to lead technical calls with US teams.
· Proven ability to work under high pressure, tight deadlines, and ambiguous situations.
· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Nice-to-Have (But Not Required):
· Direct strategic sourcing or procurement experience in high-speed connectors, backplane systems, or data center interconnects.
· Experience with precision stamping, injection molding, plating, or high-frequency materials (LCP, PPS, etc.).
· Knowledge of contract negotiation, cost breakdown, or supplier commercial management.
 
Candidate Profile Note:
Candidates with strong engineering + project management background but limited sourcing experience are strongly encouraged to apply. We provide on-the-job training in strategic sourcing for the right technical talent.
---
Key Competencies
· Technical acumen & problem-solving
· Cross-cultural collaboration
· Results-driven, resilient, and adaptable
· Strategic thinking with hands-on execution
